title: Constant polynomial from the first coordinate
statement: Let $\ell$ be a positive integer, and let $a\in\mathbb F_2^\ell$ have value $1$ at coordinate $0$ and value $0$ at every other coordinate. The polynomial $\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1} a_iX^i$ is the constant polynomial $1$.
